Description: Sets the name of the server that appears in the server list.
Primary master server for server listing. Do not alter unless you know what you are doing.
Secondary master server for server listing. Do not alter unless you know what you are doing.
Tertiary master server for server listing. Do not alter unless you know what you are doing.
Quaternary master server for server listing. Do not alter unless you know what you are doing.
Quintary master server for server listing. Do not alter unless you know what you are doing.
Sets the message of the day (MOTD) displayed when players join
If set, clients will be allowed to download content (maps, models, etc) from the server.
Sets the maximum frames per second (FPS) that the server sends to clients. Must result in a whole number frame time (1000/FPS). Valid values: 20, 25, 40, 50, 100.
Sets the minimum allowable rate a client may have set when connected to the server. 0 = no minimum.
Sets the maximum allowable rate a client may have set when connected to the server. 0 = no limit. Settings higher than 25000 do not improve the client's ping.
Sets the minimum snaps value a client can have. Lower values reduce bandwidth but may cause stuttering.
Sets the minimum ping clients can have on the server. 0 = disabled.
Sets the maximum ping clients can have on the server. 0 = disabled.
Sets the maximum number of connections allowed from a single IP address. Helps prevent crash scripts.
Sets the timeout in seconds before a dropped connection is removed. Do not alter unless you know what you are doing.
Sets the maximum number of players and spectators allowed on the server at one time.
Sets the maximum number of players (out of the Client Limit) that are able to join the game, while the rest will be spectators. 0 = disabled.
Sets the number of slots (out of the Client Limit) reserved for private players on a public server. 0 = disabled. Private Client Password must also be set.
If enabled, the server will notify clients that it requires a password to connect. The password must be set under Server Password.
Sets the password required to connect to the server. Default is no password. Require Server Password must also be enabled.
Sets the password for private clients, if any, to connect to the server. Specify the required number of private clients under Private Client Number. Server Password should not be set.
Additional console variables that are not otherwise set by AMP can be specified in 'base.cfg'. See MBII readme for details.
Sets the remote console (RCON) admin password for server administration.
Sets the password for SMOD slot 1. Configure permissions with SMOD Config 1.
Sets the permission bitmask for SMOD slot 1.
Sets the password for SMOD slot 2.
Sets the permission bitmask for SMOD slot 2.

Controls which vote types are allowed. Bitflags (additive): 0=All, 1=Gametype, 2=Map, 4=Restart Map, 8=Next Map, 16=Kick, 32=MB Mode, 64=Vote limit. Example: 18 = Map(2) + Kick(16).
If set, the server will be protected from being flooded by players via chat and admin commands.
Sets the amount of time in milliseconds that must pass between two chat messages sent by a player for them to be valid.
If set to 1, players on the banlist cannot join. If set to 0, only players on the banlist may join.
Sets the time in seconds after which an inactive client is kicked from the server. 0 = disabled.
Sets the time in seconds after which an inactive client is moved to spectator mode. 0 = disabled.
If enabled, spectators can talk to 'living' players (ghosting). 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled.
If enabled, spectators can't move freely.
If enabled, spectators cannot view the HUD from 'living' players. 0 = spectators can view HUD, 1 = hidden.

Bitwise cvar for competitive settings. Add values: 1=Hide HUD from specs, 2=Restrict spec movement, 4=No spec chat to living, 8=Spec own team only, 16=Hide enemy class icons, 32=Disable friendly indicators. 0=casual, 63=all enabled.
Controls NPC spawning. Do not alter unless you know what you are doing.
If enabled, bots will be spawned in the game.
Sets the minimum number of bots that will always be present in the game.
If enabled, bots will not send chat messages.
Fixed to Movie Battles Mode (7). This setting determines the gametype to start the server with.
Sets the Movie Battles II game mode.
Sets whether modified client files are allowed. 0 = off (any modified files allowed), 1 = only modified textures/weapons/sounds, 2 = no modified files allowed.

EnumValues.1: Only modified textures, weapons and sounds allowed.

Description: If set, cheats will be allowed on the server.
Enforces the anti-cheat system. Clients using hacks or not running the MBII Launcher will be automatically kicked.
Semi-Authentic mode: Amount of MB points players start out with.
Semi-Authentic mode: Amount of MB points players gain every round.
Limits classes on the Hero team in Open mode. 0 = all classes allowed.
Limits classes on the Villain team in Open mode. 0 = all classes allowed.
Sets the time period in Open mode. 0 = default.

Limits the number of players per class in Open Mode. 14 dash-separated values (2 digits each). 00 = disabled, 50 = default/infinite. Order: Soldier, Trooper, Commander, EliteTrooper, Sith, Jedi, BountyHunter, Hero, SBD, Wookie, Droideka, CloneTrooper, Mandalorian, ArcTrooper.
Allows or disallows Expanded Universe models in Open Mode. 0 = disallowed, 1 = allowed.
Requires Legends Mode (g_Authenticity 4). Specifies a custom Full-Authentic team. Set to 'none' to use map's default. Map restart recommended if modified while running.
Requires Legends Mode (g_Authenticity 4). Specifies a custom Full-Authentic team. Set to 'none' to use map's default. Map restart recommended if modified while running.
Sets the dismemberment probability as a percentage. 100 = maximum. Clients must also set cg_dismember accordingly to see dismemberment.
If enabled, players will automatically join a team when spawning.
If set, forces a new player onto the smallest or losing team.
Prevents teams from becoming imbalanced. -1 = off, 0 = teams must be exactly equal, 1 = allowed uneven by 1, 2 = allowed uneven by 2, etc.
Experimental. If enabled, team identities will be swapped at round start (spawns and objectives reversed). Map restart recommended if modified while server is running.
Time in seconds teams stay locked after an admin runs the shuffle command
Sets the number of won rounds a team needs to win the map. 0 = no limit.
Sets the number of captures required to end the game. 0 = no limit.
Sets the game time limit per round. 0 = no time limit. Note: MBII rounds end after 5 minutes regardless.
Sets the total number of rounds after which the map ends. Ties may happen.
Sets the respawn time period. 0 = no forced respawn. Note: MBII manages respawns per-round.
Sets the time in seconds after which weapons respawn. 0 = disabled.
If enabled, damage below 5 is ignored for TK points (minor splash damage permitted).
If TK points exceed this value, the player is forced to spectator mode.
If TK points exceed this value, the player is kicked and temporarily banned.
Number of rounds before TK points begin being forgiven.
Number of TK points forgiven per round after the forgive delay.
Number of rounds a player is temporarily banned after exceeding the TK Kick threshold.
If enabled, uses the automatic map cycle instead of a custom one. 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled.
Whether or not to permit the target_level_change map entity to function. Maps which utilize this feature can break map rotations. 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled.
Sets the filename to record logging information to. Leave blank to disable logging.
If enabled, logs client information changes (more detailed logging, useful for matching clients to IPs).
If enabled, uses synchronous appending in log writes. May impact server performance, but may provide more detailed logs if a crash occurs.
Sets the explicit logging level. Used by RTV.
Sets the name of the mod directory to load. For Movie Battles II, this should be 'MBII'.
If enabled, the server will be visible publicly. Otherwise it will only be accessible from the LAN.
Sets the map to start the server with. If "Custom" is selected, Custom Initial Map must also be specified. This setting will be overridden if map rotation is configured in 'base.cfg'.
Sets a custom map to use for the Initial Map, if "Custom" is selected
Sets whether the Initial Map allows cheats or not. Allow Cheats must also be enabled to use cheats.
